explanation.summary: 执行 Shell 命令：echo hello-tool-usage
details: 工具说明：Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Managed `$DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment f…

参数 description：Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "npm… = Run exact echo command
参数 command：The bash command to execute. = echo hello-tool-usage
参数 timeoutMs：Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed. = （未提供）
参数 workdir：Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it. = （未提供）
参数 run_in_background：Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies. = （未提供）
参数 sandbox_permissions：The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval. = （未提供）
参数 justification：Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request. = （未提供）
工具说明：查看当前会话或全部会话的工具调用统计、最近调用记录，或解释一个已注册工具及其参数。

参数 view：Report to show. "summary" = totals + tools + recent (default), "tools" = per-tool aggregates only, "recent" = recent calls only, "explain" = describe the tool named by the "tool" parameter. = summary
参数 tool：Tool name. Required for view="explain"; for the other views it filters the tools table and recent calls. = （未提供）
参数 scope：Statistics scope: the calling session (default) or all sessions. = session
参数 limit：Maximum number of recent calls, 1-100. Default 20. = （未提供）
